record.what_it_does: Front is a customer communication/helpdesk platform (shared inbox, tickets, chat, SMS) with a Core API to sync data, automate replies, and manage conversations, plus an official MCP server for AI agents.
record.auth_notes: Front issues static API tokens (Bearer) for single-workspace/internal integrations, and OAuth2 for app-framework/public integrations and the MCP server. Front requires OAuth for public integrations distributed via its App Store unless an exception is granted. The MCP server requires a confidential OAuth 2.1 + PKCE connection (client_id + client_secret); Dynamic Client Registration is not supported.
record.access_notes: Anyone can sign up for a free Front developer account with a sandbox environment (no production data, limited to 3 teammates) and immediately generate API tokens or create an OAuth app to call the Core API and MCP server. Production use against a real company's data requires that company to have a paid Front plan (Starter/Professional/Enterprise all include API access with tiered rate limits); public App Store distribution of an OAuth integration favors/requires partnering with Front.
record.main_blocker: Production use requires the end customer to already have a paid Front plan; OAuth apps must be manually created per-company in Front settings (no public self-serve client without going through Front's App Store/partner review).
